items.source: Read an object of the given type from the given input message, and returns it.
items.translation: 从给定的输入消息中读取给定类型的对象，并返回它。

items.source: Write a given object to the given output message.
items.translation: 将给定对象写入给定的输出消息中。

items.source: IOException - in case of I/O errors
items.translation: `IOException` - 在发生 I/O 错误时

items.source: Indicates whether the given class can be written by this converter.
items.translation: 指示该转换器是否可以写入给定类。

items.source: It provides default methods for HttpMessageConverter in order to allow subclasses to only have to implement the smart APIs.
items.translation: 它为HttpMessageConverter提供了默认方法，以便子类只需实现智能 API。

items.source: Indicates whether the given class can be read by this converter.
items.translation: 指示该转换器是否可以读取给定的类。

items.source: type - the (potentially generic) type of object to write. This type must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true. Can be ResolvableType.NONE if not specified. The type source may be used for retrieving additional information (the related method signature for example) when relevant.
items.translation: type - 要写入的（可能是泛型的）对象类型。此类型必须此前已传递给该接口的 canWrite 方法，且该方法必须返回 true。若未指定，可以是 ResolvableType.NONE。当需要时，类型源 可用于检索附加信息（例如相关方法签名）。

items.source: contentType - the content type to use when writing. May be null to indicate that the default content type of the converter must be used. If not null, this media type must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: `contentType` - 写入时使用的内容类型。若为 `null`，则指示必须使用转换器默认的内容类型。如果非 `null`，此媒体类型必须已传递给该接口的 canWrite 方法，且该方法必须返回 `true`。

items.source: targetType - the (potentially generic) target type to test for writability (can be ResolvableType.NONE if not specified). The type source may be used for retrieving additional information (the related method signature for example) when relevant.
items.translation: targetType - 要测试可写性的（可能是泛型的）目标类型（如果未指定，可以是 ResolvableType.NONE）。在需要时，可以使用 类型源 检索附加信息（例如相关方法签名）。

items.source: t - the object to write to the output message. The type of this object must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: t - 要写入输出消息的对象。此对象的类型必须先前已传递给本接口的canWrite方法，且该方法必须返回true。

items.source: mediaType - the media type to write (can be null if not specified); typically the value of an Accept header.
items.translation: `mediaType` - 要写入的媒体类型（如果未指定，可以为 `null`）；通常是 `Accept` 头的值。

items.source: true if readable; false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示可读；否则为 false。

items.source: HttpMessageNotReadableException - in case of conversion errors
items.translation: HttpMessageNotReadableException - 在转换错误时

items.source: true if writable; false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示可写；否则为 false。

items.source: HttpMessageNotWritableException - in case of conversion errors
items.translation: HttpMessageNotWritableException - 在转换错误时

items.source: inputMessage - the HTTP input message to read from
items.translation: inputMessage - 要读取的 HTTP 输入消息

items.source: hints - additional information about how to encode
items.translation: hints - 关于如何编码的附加信息

items.source: valueClass - the source object class to test for writability
items.translation: valueClass - 用于测试可写性的源对象类

items.source: outputMessage - the message to write to
items.translation: outputMessage - 要写入的消息。

items.source: the converted object
items.translation: 已转换的对象

items.translation: 此方法应执行与HttpMessageConverter.canWrite(Class, MediaType)相同的检查，并增加与泛型类型相关的额外检查。
